gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-tasa-orbiter: Neon-tube thickness defines Bruno Ace, drawn with a ruler's constant width, while TASA Orbiter keeps its small counters unclogged. Heavy glow over light text is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-teachers: Bruno Ace lingers over each character, its ruler-drawn line never changing width. Teachers is drawn like thin bent steel rod, strokes tapering out before they touch, which keeps running text light and modern.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-tirra: A constant, marker-like line gives Bruno Ace its look, while the round forms of Tirra resemble open parentheses. Whole paragraphs in sans-serif Tirra would read smooth, modern and unfussy.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-titillium-web: Uniform and deliberate: Bruno Ace draws bowls and stems at the same weight, heavy against its lighter partner. Titillium Web keeps its stroke ends far apart, so extended sans-serif reading feels approachable and current.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-tuffy: Ruler-straight and unhurried: Bruno Ace lingers on each letter, while Tuffy sketches its sans with a pencil that never bears down. Give Bruno Ace the larger size and let Tuffy stay modest.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-varela: Distinctive Bruno Ace holds a ruler-drawn line, while Varela gives its c a wide-mouthed, approachable look. Shrink the heading or enlarge the body and the weight gap would vanish.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-wix-madefor-display: Expressive Bruno Ace holds one ruler-drawn line, with no calligraphic modulation. Wix Madefor Display brings gently flared curve ends that stay apart, giving the heading a softer companion beneath it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-wix-madefor-text: Bruno Ace draws a plain, unmodulated outline with a lingering rhythm. Wix Madefor Text has easy-to-read open terminals and would hold up at a much smaller size than the heading.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ysabeau: Bruno Ace looks cut from wire, every stroke the same constant width and each character lingering. But Ysabeau sweeps broad sans curves that never close up, a loose counterpoint to that rigid wire.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ysabeau-infant: Outward-pointing terminals like a pair of tongs give Ysabeau Infant an approachable, contemporary read. Ysabeau Infant meets the ruler-drawn, unthinning line of Bruno Ace with a lighter sans touch, and that gap is the appeal.
